ॠ: ॠ ऌ ॡ No Sanskrit word begins with any of these vowels; ॠ appears only in the gen. plur. of nouns terminating in ऋ, in the acc. plur. of fem. nouns. of relationship in ऋ, and in the nom. and acc. plur. of neuter nouns in ऋ। As to the vowel ऌ it occurs only in some forms of the root कॢप्। The long ॡ is a mere invention of grammarians.

ॠ 1. ॠ, ind. a particle uttered at the be-ginning of a speech; an interjection of warding off reproach and terror; (ॠस् or री), f. the mother of the gods; also of the demons; recollection; (आ), m. a N. of Bhairava; a Dānava or demon; the breast; motion, going. —ॠ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ॠ।
ॠ 2. ॠ for rt. 4. ऋ, q. v.
